title: Function Health footer
description: A cream band holding one big page-coloured card with rounded bottom corners and a wide soft shadow: wordmark in terracotta, three link columns, a newsletter block (serif line with italic ending, lead, pill email field and Submit pill), app QR and store buttons, round social icons and small legal links. Fine-print paragraphs sit below the card on the cream. On phones the newsletter moves above the link columns.
notes: social icons come in as nodes (lucide-react has no brand icons)
QR code and store buttons are media slots
